draft.stem: The stopping-potential versus frequency graphs for two metals are shown. Which comparison of their work functions is correct?

figure.description: Draw Cartesian axes with horizontal axis labelled frequency, $\nu$ ($10^{14}$ Hz), and vertical axis labelled stopping potential, $V_s$ (V). Draw two straight, parallel rising lines in the first quadrant. Label the upper-left line segment A and the lower-right line segment B. Line A crosses the frequency axis at $4$ and passes through $(6, 0.8)$; line B crosses at $6$ and passes through $(8, 0.8)$.

draft.distractor_notes: B: assumes equal work functions despite different threshold frequencies. C: reverses the threshold-frequency comparison. D: overlooks that the frequency-axis intercept gives the threshold frequency.
